part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `src/diff/props.js:95`: `onfocusin`/`onfocusout` are not valid DOM properties (the actual events are `focusin`/`focusout`), so the `name.toLowerCase() in dom` check failed and Preact registered listeners for the non-standard `FocusIn`/`FocusOut` events. Added a special case so `onFocusIn`/`onFocusOut` are lowercased to `focusin`/`focusout` before registering.

Verification: all 1145 browser tests (including the camel-case focus test at `test/browser/events.test.js:231`) plus 29 shared/node tests pass.
